output.orig_prompt: Luxury watch commercial, cinematic shot. The camera makes a slow, deep lateral tracking move from left to right around the watch resting on black volcanic rock, revealing parallax between the rock and the dark background; the beam of warm light slowly moves across the steel case and the leather strap; fine golden dust particles drift and glitter through the beam. Keep the watch exactly identical: same dial, sub-dials, numbers, bezel, case and strap. Smooth, elegant, physically realistic motion. No text, no logo, no people, no hands. No people in frame.
